z09-review-september.note: Rejected: the marker points at box 8, so the picture could be read as month 8. Not installed; September returns in the review as a listening card without a picture.

z11-review-november.observed_description: The year planner with one blue loop around box 11 and, reaching in from the right, an adult hand holding a blue whiteboard marker whose tip touches the end of the loop. The hand hides most of the number 12; boxes 1 to 11 are readable; no words.
z11-review-november.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). One loop, on box 11, with the marker at the loop. The hand covers the number 12, which the prompt asked it not to; the looped month is still unambiguous.
